corruptSays.line: Rosa looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.

◈ FLASHBACK — Photo Album
Faces from before. Niamh's wedding. Your dad asleep in the chair. The neighbor's kid with the missing tooth. The most valuable thing you own, and it weighs nothing.

◈ FLASHBACK — Knife roll
The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.

◈ FLASHBACK — Tasting Spoon
Your first Saturday service, you were sixteen and the chef handed you this spoon without a word. Tap twice, taste, know. You still tap twice — the tickets are gone but the habit isn't.

◈ FLASHBACK — Lucky Coin
Worn smooth. Gavriil flipped it before every hard thing and said: heads or tails, it always lands on keep going. You have stopped checking which side lands.

People will notice: watches people's hands, not their faces — like appraising tools. Let them. It's useful, being underestimated — or feared.

INNER VOICE: the others are already afraid. Fear is a kind of respect that doesn't ask for anything back. You could build something here — not on trust. On what people will do to stay on your good side. (Corruption starts at 20. The slope is yours to walk — or not.)
